 Search The Site The $1,400 Check For Older Americans And Where It Stands
 Bruce Mikells Bruce Mikells Published: November 20, 2026 Share on Facebook 
 Share on Twitter 
 Back in the day, during Civics class, I learned about how the United States government is supposed to work. The Founding Fathers created a system of "checks and balances" so no branch of government could gain overarching authority. I must admit, they certainly appear to have the "checks" part right. Yes, we have another stimulus-check proposal to offer you some insight.
 Photo by Money Knack on Unsplash A pen rests on a check near the dollars line We will put this in the same bucket as the other checks that have been proposed. You might recall the "If Republicans maintain control check", "the Tariff Rebate", "the DOGE Dividend", and the granddaddy of them all, "COVID Stimulus".
 What is the Most Recent Stimulus Check Offering From the U.S. Government?
 The most recent "send 'em a check" idea comes from a California Congressman who thinks the conflict with Iran was done illegally. He thinks that because that war caused prices to rise, the United States should reimburse Americans for the added expense.
 All of the checks that we've mentioned so far have been the idea of an elected official. This next "federal stimulus" is coming from a group of, we have to assume, older Americans who call themselves the Senior Citizens League. 
 Photo by Cristina Gottardi on Unsplash group of old men sitting near table That group is calling on Congress to issue a special, one-time stimulus for Social Security recipients to cover shortfalls created by the current inflationary state of the economy. The group acknowledges Social Security's recent Cost of Living Adjustment. 
 The Senior Citizens League suggests that an increase of 3.6% is not enough for those on Social Security benefits to maintain their current standard of living. In addition to the one-time stimulus payment of $1,400, the group is asking for changes in the current tax laws.
 READ MORE : $1,700 Planned Payment for American Families Just Announced 
 They are specifically asking for reforms in the Social Security Payroll tax threshold. The Senior Citizens League believes lifting or eliminating that would close a loophole that many of the wealthy use to avoid paying their fair share into the program.
 In Addition to $1,400, Senior Citizens Would Receive More Healthcare Benefits
 Photo by Vitaly Gariev on Unsplash Doctor consults with grandfather and grandson in office The group is also asking Congress to add dental, vision, and hearing care to Medicare coverage. So, this isn't a "money grab"; this is more of a wake-up call for elected officials. Perhaps the group's concerns might need some more study, and perhaps a policy change might be the right solution. At least there is a dialogue started.
 Which is a nice way of saying this will never show up in your account. Much like many of the others that have been talked about and promised. Looks like we'll have to go out and earn money the old-fashioned way.

 Of course I am talking about the lottery, that scratching tickets, it's hard work. 
 Louisiana Lottery's Best "Value" Scratch-Off Stocking Stuffers For Christmas 2026
 Scratch-off lottery tickets have always been a favorite holiday gift to give and to receive, at least they are for me. The prospect of you gifting someone thousands of dollars is both exciting and excruciating. What if the winning ticket went to the family member you can't stand? Such is life and such are the holidays. We broke down the current scratch-off offerings from the Louisiana Lottery, and we figured out which games offer you the best chance to "give someone a winner" if you choose to stuff their stocking with scratch-offs.
